preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 1500
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1500) representing the number of computers.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == n + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n lines after the first line, each with n integers representing the adjacency matrix a_{i,j}.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i][i] == 0 for i in range(n)) and all(a[i][j] > 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j) and all(a[i][j] == a[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: The adjacency matrix satisfies: a_{i,i} = 0, a_{i,j} > 0 for i ≠ j, and a_{i,j} = a_{j,i}. All a_{i,j} for i < j are distinct (implied by the problem statement).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(count % 998244353) for count in counts] and len(counts) == n
postconditions.description: The output is a list of n integers, where the k-th integer (1 ≤ k ≤ n) is the number of valid ways to partition the n computers into k non-empty subsets, modulo 998244353. A partition is valid if for every pair of computers (s, f) in the same subset and every pair (x, y) in different subsets, a_{s,f} < a_{x,y}.
Each count in the output is a non-negative integer.
